desc:
🎬 Welcome to Animate It! — Roblox Animation & Movie Maker!

Create animations, movies, cartoons, and funny clips! Animate characters, pose avatars, build scenes, and bring your stories to life!

✨ ANIMATE — Pose characters, customize rigs, and create smooth Roblox animations!

🎥 MAKE MOVIES — Direct short films, animated stories, cinematic scenes, and cartoons!

🎭 CUSTOMIZE — Edit avatars, add props, build scenes, and create special effects!

🎮 CREATE ANYTHING — Make memes, dance animations, fight scenes, music videos, and roleplays!

🔁 WATCH, SHARE & REMIX — Discover community movies, share your creations, and remix animations!

🛠️ ROBLOX STUDIO PLUGIN — Export animations and scenes into your own Roblox games!

🔗 Get the official plugin:
https://create.roblox.com/store/asset/108388603519536
